text: Democrats Storm Out: Pam Bondi’s Epstein Files Briefing Ends in Chaos | Full Report | N18GThe political temperature in Washington has reached a boiling point following a closed-door briefing on Wednesday, March 18, 2026. summary: Democrats Storm Out: Pam Bondi’s Epstein Files Briefing Ends in Chaos | Full Report | N18GThe political temperature in Washington has reached a boiling point following a closed-door briefing on Wednesday, March 18, 2026. Democratic lawmakers on the House Oversight Committee staged a dramatic walkout less than an hour into a session with Attorney General Pam Bondi and Deputy AG Todd Blanche. The walkout was triggered by Bondi's refusal to commit to honoring a subpoena for a sworn deposition on April 14, which was authorized with bipartisan support earlier this month.
